RacingCar adaptations: material groups batched, wheels separated, steering wheel extracted for animation, URP materials and rear brake-light emission, cockpit telemetry, camera positions, collision and custom rear-wheel-drive handling. Original source geometry preserved in Source/.
Physics are game tuning rather than certified vehicle specifications.
